args.sql:
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ra.txref,
    ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' AS transaction_pattern_category,
    sm.threat_analysis_metrics->>'anomaly_detection_score' AS anomaly_score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(sm.threat_analysis_metrics->>'anomaly_detection_score' AS DECIMAL) DESC) AS rank
FROM 
    riskanalysis AS ra
JOIN 
    securitymonitoring AS sm ON ra.riskregistry = sm.riskref
WHERE 
    ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' IN ('High-risk', 'Suspicious');

events.sql:
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ra.txref,
    ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' AS transaction_pattern_category,
    sm.threat_analysis_metrics->>'anomaly_detection_score' AS anomaly_score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(sm.threat_analysis_metrics->>'anomaly_detection_score' AS DECIMAL) DESC) AS rank
FROM 
    riskanalysis AS ra
JOIN 
    securitymonitoring AS sm ON ra.riskregistry = sm.riskref
WHERE 
    ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' IN ('High-risk', 'Suspicious');
